channel.title: Botswana - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Botswana, every source cited.

item.title: Botswana reaffirms opposition to Taiwan independence
item.description: Gaborone's stance on Taiwan's sovereignty draws criticism and prompts questions about self-determination.

item.title: Botswana struggles against human trafficking
item.description: The 2026 Trafficking in Persons Report keeps Botswana on Tier 2, citing progress but persistent exploitation.

item.title: Ramaotwana asked to probe Masisi-linked trust dispute
item.description: Acting chief Kgosi Oscar Mosielele seeks investigation into alleged mismanagement of the Ipelego Community Trust.

item.title: Bank of Botswana holds interest rate at 5.5 percent
item.description: Inflation cooled to 7.8 percent in September, but remains above the central bank's target range.

item.title: Botswana VP offers alternative to IMF wage cuts
item.description: Vice President Ndaba Gaolathe proposed tackling waste and project costs before reducing public sector jobs.
